mechanism: Nafcillin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases tramadol metabolism, reducing tramadol plasma concentrations and analgesic efficacy while potentially increasing formation of the active metabolite M1 (O-desmethyltramadol).
action: Monitor analgesic efficacy closely; tramadol dose may need to be increased, but balance against serotonin syndrome risk from increased M1 metabolite formation; consider alternative analgesics if inadequate pain control.
